in_arabic.name: نويلة
in_arabic.long_meaning: The name Nuwaylah is derived from the Arabic root 'nawwala', which means 'to flow, to be radiant, or to shine'. The name signifies brightness, radiance, or luminousness.

in_urdu.name: نویلہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: The name Nuwaylah in Urdu translates to 'sarakhtein, sarakh, or taba'iyat'. It signifies brightness, radiance, or transformation.

in_hindi.name: नुवायला
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Nuwaylah in Hindi translates to 'sūraj kā anupraveś, tāpas, or antarvijñāna'. It signifies the manifestation of the sun, fiery, or inner knowledge.

in_pashto.name: نويله
in_pashto.long_meaning: The name Nuwaylah in Pashto translates to 'lašwok, bahar, or xudkārī'. It signifies joyful, spring, or independent.
